minimal_first_batch.stages: Existing nonsaving original-rule DRC plus narrowly declared intent readback; source/tool/project/process/full reports retained.

cases.change: Owned conventional two-terminal routed fixture, complete original project and ordinary documentation-layer text.
cases.expectation: No target findings, opens, blocking or exclusions; warnings retained.

cases.change: Set only one owned named nondefault class tuning_profile to MissingOwnedProfile; definitions remain empty.
cases.expectation: Actual missing_tuning_profile warning with original warning severity; future application guard rejects intent/finding.

cases.change: Set only Default.tuning_profile to MissingOwnedProfile on another copy.
cases.expectation: Coverage probe: source suggests direct named-class provider loop omits Default. Record actual outcome; source guard rejects regardless.
cases.classification: not a provider pass if finding absent

cases.change: Move only a fixed UUID gr_text from Dwgs.User to Edge.Cuts.
cases.expectation: text_on_edge_cuts:error bound to exact UUID; additional raw outline findings retained.

cases.change: Move only a fixed UUID fp_text or field from F.Fab to Edge.Cuts.
cases.expectation: text_on_edge_cuts:error bound to exact nested item UUID; confirms nested traversal.

cases.change: On a new PTH/track fixture copy add (front_post_machining counterbore (size 1.2) (depth 0.2)) to the pad only; choose original-rule-compliant original pad/hole and fixed F.Cu track.
cases.expectation: Native nonzero front mode/size/depth retained and track_on_post_machined_layer:error exactly track+pad; absent finding is failed qualification.
cases.limits: Prospective parser recipe only; connectivity precondition/DRC outcome unexecuted. Ordinary positive must first be clean.

cases.change: Separate connected through-via copy with (backdrill (size 0.8) (layers "F.Cu" "B.Cu")); fixed corresponding ordinary hole smaller than0.8.
cases.expectation: Actual intent retained and exact track+via target finding; otherwise remain unsupported.
cases.limits: Separate later branch, not inferred from pad case; physical/stackup correctness unqualified.

cases.change: Owned annotated matched schematic/board pair; change only one custom footprint field, preserve all net/pad data; explicit parity option only after verified command support.
cases.expectation: Matched pair positive, exact footprint_symbol_field_mismatch on negative, proof netlist/parity actually ran. No-parity negative is coverage-only.
